description: Template court hierarchy seeded at realm init. Quarter-scoped courts are created on every quarter (litigations are always filed locally); capital-scoped courts only exist on the capital, which hears appeals from the quarters.

justice_system.name: Syntropia Justice
justice_system.description: Public justice system of the Syntropia city-realm: local community courts under a single constitutional court.

courts.name: Community Court
courts.description: Court of first instance for disputes between citizens, land and lease matters, and administrative claims.

courts.name: Constitutional Court
courts.description: The city's highest court: hears appeals from Community Courts and rules on constitutional questions.
